features_repo.comment: Where local (repo-owned) features are sourced from: this repo's features/ dir. Candidates are relative to this catalog's directory; ~ paths are host home.

pi_master.comment: Seed for each repo's .devcontainer/pi (bind-mounted as ~/.pi). Includes shared credentials (auth.json, models-store.json, pi-reach/) - do not commit publicly. Sync semantics: generation materializes ONLY when .devcontainer/pi is missing/empty (bootstrap); afterwards it is never touched except via explicit --sync-pi (copy-if-older, never deletes target-only files).

features.comment: Non-root user + passwordless sudo + common CLI utils
Node.js via nvm; global npm installs work without sudo

features.help: Installed with --ignore-scripts. Hard-requires the node feature: pi runs on Node.js.

features.comment: Renode portable simulator + GTK/X11 deps + Robot Framework
Ghidra + bundled MCP server (needs a JDK)
features.help: Installs Ghidra to /opt/ghidra and sets GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR. The MCPSERVER option picks the MCP server: 'ghidrassist' (default, native MCP server on :8080) or 'ghidramcp' (fork with bridge on :8089).

prompts.prompt: MCP server stack (ghidrassist = native extension :8080; ghidramcp = fork + bridge :8089)
Ghidra version ('none' skips download; URL resolved via GitHub releases API)

features.comment: usbip client: manually attach network-shared USB devices
features.help: Installs the usbip client plus usbip-list / usbip-attach / usbip-detach helpers. Attach manually with usbip-attach -b <busid>; the server is $USBIP_HOST or host.docker.internal, and may be the host or any remote machine running usbipd. The node is created in the container via mknod - no /dev/bus mount. Needs vhci_hcd on the kernel owner (host: modprobe vhci_hcd) and the usb-cgroup addon (auto-selected).

apt_groups.comment: ARM Cortex-M embedded toolchain + pyOCD debug
Cross binutils only (aarch64 + armhf object inspection)
Android reverse engineering (apktool, smali, adb, capstone...)
sigrok CLI logic analyzer + fx2lafw firmware
Deps for building SDCC/CPCtelera from source

addons.comment: USB passthrough, incl. devices plugged in later
addons.help: Mounts /dev/bus/usb and grants a usb device-cgroup rule, so devices connected after container start appear automatically - including devices the host attaches via usbip (vhci devices land on the host bus like physical ones; attachment is managed on the host, no container-side usbip tooling needed). Conflicts with usb-basic.

addons.comment: USB passthrough (devices present at start only)
addons.help: Mounts /dev/bus/usb at container creation. Devices plugged in afterwards are not visible - use usb-hotplug for that. Conflicts with usb-hotplug.

addons.comment: Allow dynamic USB device nodes (usbip attach) - no mounts
addons.help: Grants the device cgroup access to dynamically created USB nodes (major 189) so usbip-attach can create and open them inside the container. No mounts and no /dev/bus access. Required by the usbip feature.

addons.comment: X11/Wayland GUI apps from host display

addons.help: The mount source is materialized from pi-master on first generation (copy-if-older), so existing runtime state is never overwritten by regeneration.
Mounts the host ~/.ssh into the container. For HTTPS git auth via the host keyring, prefer git-credential-libsecret.

addons.comment: Run as vscode user, match host UID
Machine-specific: mount the other repos into /workspaces
addons.help: Bind-mounts the host repo layout (~/github/*, ~/Projects/*) into /workspaces. Only meaningful on machines using that layout.

addons.comment: Host libsecret credential helper over D-Bus
addons.help: Installs libsecret-1-0 (+ build deps), mounts the host session bus ($XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus -> /tmp/host-dbus/bus, DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS set), builds git-credential-libsecret post-create from git's contrib (Debian does not ship the binary) into ~/.local/bin and registers it as the global credential helper. Sets credential.useHttpPath so stored credentials are scoped to the individual repository path.

postCreateCommand.git-credential-libsecret: set -e; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; if [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/bin/git-credential-libsecret" ]; then rm -rf "$HOME/.cache/git-contrib"; git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/git/git.git "$HOME/.cache/git-contrib"; make -C "$HOME/.cache/git-contrib/contrib/credential/libsecret"; install -m 0755 "$HOME/.cache/git-contrib/contrib/credential/libsecret/git-credential-libsecret" "$HOME/.local/bin/"; fi; git config --global --get credential.helper | grep -qx libsecret || git config --global --add credential.helper libsecret
